# setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(setup_dir, "setup.R"))
source(file.path(setup_dir, "functions-yossef.R"))
plots_list <- list()
sample <- "yossef-cohort"
batch_dir <- file.path(datapath, sample)
```

# load

Public data from Yossef et al. Estimation of ambient RNA contamination using SoupX:
<https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SoupX/vignettes/pbmcTutorial.html>
<https://www.sc-best-practices.org/preprocessing_visualization/quality_control.html>
<https://cellgeni.github.io/notebooks/html/new-10kPBMC-SoupX.html>

SoupX is used as a QC step only: the contamination fraction (rho) is estimated per sample, but counts are not corrected (no adjustCounts()), so the downstream object is built from the uncorrected matrix. autoEstCont() relies on cluster-specific genes, which are scarce in sorted T cells, so the estimate is fragile; forceAccept = TRUE only prevents the run from stopping when an implausible value is estimated. Estimated rho = 0.01-0.03 in all samples except RY4422-CD8-2 (0.65), which SoupX itself flags as a failure of the estimation rather than real contamination.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
folder_data <- file.path("single-cell", sample)
object_files <- list.files(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data))
object_tags <- c("3791", "4180", "4180", "4246", "4287", "4317", "4324", "4324", "4359", "4359", "4422", "4422")
object_YR <- list()
soupX_YR <- list()
for (i in seq_along(object_files)) {
  toc <- Read10X(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data, object_files[i], "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
  toc_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(toc)
  object_YR[[as.character(object_files[i])]] <- toc_seurat
  object_YR[[as.character(object_files[i])]]$tag <- paste0(object_tags[i], "_")
  tod <- Read10X(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data, object_files[i], "raw_feature_bc_matrix"))
  sc <- SoupChannel(tod, toc)
  toc_seurat <- PercentageFeatureSet(toc_seurat, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
  set.seed(SEED)
  toc_seurat <- SCTransform(toc_seurat, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE, seed.use = 1448145)
  toc_seurat <- RunPCA(toc_seurat, verbose = FALSE, seed.use = SEED)
  toc_seurat <- RunTSNE(toc_seurat, dims = 1:10, seed.use = SEED)
  toc_seurat <- RunUMAP(toc_seurat, dims = 1:10, seed.use = SEED)
  toc_seurat <- FindNeighbors(toc_seurat, dims = 1:10, verbose = FALSE)
  toc_seurat <- FindClusters(toc_seurat, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 1.2, random.seed = SEED)
  DefaultAssay(toc_seurat) <- "RNA"
  meta <- toc_seurat@meta.data
  umap <- toc_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
  sc <- setClusters(sc, setNames(meta$seurat_clusters, rownames(meta)))
  sc <- setDR(sc, umap)
  set.seed(SEED)
  sc <- autoEstCont(sc, forceAccept = TRUE)
  soupX_YR[[as.character(object_files[i])]] <- sc
  rm(toc, toc_seurat, tod, sc, meta, umap, i)
}
dir.create(file.path(batch_dir, "seurat"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(soupX_YR, file.path(batch_dir, "seurat", "soupX_yossef.rds"))
rm(object_files, object_tags)
```

IC01 - Gene contribution to the SoupX.

```{r}
plots_soupX <- list()
for (i in names(soupX_YR)) {
  data_i <- head(soupX_YR[[i]]$soupProfile[order(soupX_YR[[i]]$soupProfile$est, decreasing = TRUE), ], n = 50)
  data_i$gene <- as.character(row.names(data_i))
  data_i$gene <- factor(data_i$gene, levels = data_i$gene)
  data_i$source <- ifelse(grepl("^MT-", data_i$gene), "mito",
                          ifelse(grepl("^RPS|^RPL", data_i$gene), "ribo", "other"))
  plot_i <- ggplot(data_i, aes(x = gene, y = est, fill = source)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    ylim(0, 0.13) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(source == "other", as.character(gene), "")), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.5, angle = 45) +
    labs(title = i, x = NULL, y = "soupX est") +
    theme_light() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 0.5)
  plots_soupX[[as.character(i)]] <- plot_i
}
plots_list[["IC01_soupX"]] <- wrap_plots(plots_soupX, ncol = length(names(soupX_YR)) / 2)
print(plots_list$IC01_soupX)
rm(soupX_YR, plots_soupX, i, data_i, plot_i)
```


IC04 - Quality of cells with high MT and RBP content.

```{r}
metadata <- object@meta.data
metrics <- c("percent.mt", "percent.rpl", "percent.rps", "percent.rpa")
qc_curves <- list()
for (i in metrics) {
  thresholds <- seq(0, 70, by = 1)
  results <- data.frame(threshold = numeric(), passing_cells = numeric(), tag_data = character())
  for (j in unique(metadata$tag)) {
    tag_data <- metadata[metadata$tag == j, ]
    for (k in thresholds) {
      percent_passing <- mean(tag_data[[i]] <= k)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(threshold = k, passing_cells = percent_passing, tag = j))
      results$tag <- factor(results$tag, levels = unique(object@meta.data$tag))
    }
  }
  plot_i <- ggplot(results, aes(x = threshold, y = passing_cells, color = tag, fill = tag)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    labs(title = i, x = paste0("max_", i), y = "percent_passing_filter") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, by = 10)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          aspect.ratio = 1)
  if (i == "percent.mt") {
    plot_i <- plot_i +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(10), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
  }
  qc_curves[[i]] <- plot_i
}
plots_list[["IC04_qc_mt"]] <- wrap_plots(qc_curves, ncol = 2)
print(plots_list$IC04_qc_mt)
rm(metadata, metrics, qc_curves, i, j, k, thresholds, results, tag_data, percent_passing, plot_i)
```

Tag cells between 10-20% percent.mt to check where they fall in the umap.

First, the 20% cutoff will be considered and where these cells fall will be evaluated.

```{r}
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt > 20, "elim_mt", NA)
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt >= 15 & object$percent.mt <= 20, "high_mt", object$tag.mt)
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt >= 10 & object$percent.mt < 15, "int_mt", object$tag.mt)
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt < 10, "low_mt", object$tag.mt)
object$tag.mt <- factor(object$tag.mt, levels = c("elim_mt", "low_mt", "int_mt", "high_mt"))
mt_table <- table(object$tag.mt, object$tag)
print(mt_table)
rm(mt_table)
```

# filtering

Elimination of cells with >20% percent.mt and without TCR info + genes detected in <5 cells.
TCR V(D)J and ribosomal genes are kept in the matrix (they contribute to library size and normalization). They are excluded downstream: from integration (genes.blacklist.default in STACAS) and from DE/signatures (excluded_signature_genes() in setup/functions.R).

```{r}
counts <- GetAssayData(object = object, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
expressed_genes <- rowSums(counts > 0) >= 5
keep_genes <- names(expressed_genes[expressed_genes])
all_cells <- rownames(object@meta.data)
elim_cells_mt <- all_cells[object@meta.data$tag.mt == "elim_mt"]
elim_cells_tcr <- all_cells[object@meta.data$tag.tcr == "no"]
keep_cells <- setdiff(all_cells, c(elim_cells_mt, elim_cells_tcr))
object <- subset(object,
                 features = keep_genes,
                 cells = keep_cells
)
rm(counts, expressed_genes, keep_genes, all_cells, elim_cells_mt, elim_cells_tcr, keep_cells)
```

# doublets

Automated annotation using scDblFinder:
<https://github.com/plger/scDblFinder?tab=readme-ov-file>
<https://plger.github.io/scDblFinder/articles/scDblFinder.html>

```{r, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(SEED)
# --- Convert to SingleCellExperiment for scDblFinder ---
sce_obj <- as.SingleCellExperiment(object, assay = "RNA")
colData(sce_obj)$tag <- object$tag
sce_obj <- scDblFinder(
  sce_obj,
  samples = "tag",
  clusters = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(RNGseed = SEED)
)
# --- Copy doublet calls back to the Seurat object ---
object$scDblFinder.score <- sce_obj$scDblFinder.score
object$scDblFinder.class <- sce_obj$scDblFinder.class
table(object$scDblFinder.class)
rm(sce_obj)
```

Doublet removal. Doublets with a reactive TCR (same patient + reactive TRA and TRB, as in the reactivity annotation below) are kept.

```{r}
tcr_reactivity <- fread(file.path(resources_dir, "yossef-cohort", "yossef-reactive-tcrs.tsv")) %>% as.data.frame()
is_reactive <- !is.na(match_reactive_tcr_yossef(sub("_.*", "", object$tag), object$chains, object$cdr3, tcr_reactivity))
table(doublet = object$scDblFinder.class, reactive = is_reactive)
keep_cells <- colnames(object)[object$scDblFinder.class != "doublet" | is_reactive]
object <- subset(object, cells = keep_cells)
table(object$scDblFinder.class)
rm(tcr_reactivity, is_reactive, keep_cells)
```

# tags

Annotate TCRalpha/beta clonotype data.

```{r}
chains_data <- object@meta.data %>%
  select(chains, cdr3, v_gene, j_gene) %>%
  mutate(
    chain_split = strsplit(as.character(chains), ";"),
    cdr3_split = strsplit(as.character(cdr3), ";"),
    v_split = strsplit(as.character(v_gene), ";"),
    j_split = strsplit(as.character(j_gene), ";")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    TCRa = {
      tra_idx <- which(chain_split == "TRA")
      if (length(tra_idx) > 0) {
        clean_v <- gsub("-1", "", v_split[tra_idx])
        clean_v <- gsub("\\*\\d+", "", clean_v)
        clean_j <- gsub("-1", "", j_split[tra_idx])
        clean_j <- gsub("\\*\\d+", "", clean_j)
        paste(
          mapply(
            function(c, v, j) paste0(c, "_", v, "_", j),
            cdr3_split[tra_idx],
            clean_v,
            clean_j
          ),
          collapse = ";"
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    },
    TCRb = {
      trb_idx <- which(chain_split == "TRB")
      if (length(trb_idx) > 0) {
        clean_v <- gsub("-1", "", v_split[trb_idx])
        clean_v <- gsub("\\*\\d+", "", clean_v)
        clean_j <- gsub("-1", "", j_split[trb_idx])
        clean_j <- gsub("\\*\\d+", "", clean_j)
        paste(
          mapply(
            function(c, v, j) paste0(c, "_", v, "_", j),
            cdr3_split[trb_idx],
            clean_v,
            clean_j
          ),
          collapse = ";"
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-chain_split, -cdr3_split, -v_split, -j_split)
object$cell_id <- rownames(object@meta.data)
chains_data$cell_id <- object@meta.data$cell_id
chains_data <- chains_data %>% select(cell_id, TCRa, TCRb)
object@meta.data <- object@meta.data %>% left_join(chains_data, by = "cell_id") %>% column_to_rownames("cell_id")
object@meta.data$cell_id <- row.names(object@meta.data)
rm(chains_data)
```

Reactive T cells by Yossef et al. A cell is reactive when it carries both the reactive TRA and TRB CDR3 of a TCR reported for its patient; extra chains (e.g. a second TRA) are allowed. Cells with only one of the two chains stay as "Other". `clonotype` is the reactive TCR (TRA;TRB) for reactive cells and `cdr3` otherwise, so that cells of one reactive clone with an extra chain count as a single clonotype in m05.

```{r}
tcr_reactivity <- fread(file.path(resources_dir, "yossef-cohort", "yossef-reactive-tcrs.tsv")) %>% as.data.frame()
meta <- object@meta.data
meta$patient <- sub("_.*", "", meta$tag)
reactive_idx <- match_reactive_tcr_yossef(meta$patient, meta$chains, meta$cdr3, tcr_reactivity)
meta$Mutation <- tcr_reactivity$Mutation[reactive_idx]
meta$reactive <- ifelse(is.na(reactive_idx), NA_character_, "yes")
meta$clonotype <- ifelse(
  is.na(reactive_idx),
  meta$cdr3,
  paste0(tcr_reactivity$TCRa[reactive_idx], ";", tcr_reactivity$TCRb[reactive_idx])
)
object@meta.data <- meta
rownames(object@meta.data) <- object@meta.data$cell_id
# --- Reactive TCRs without any matching cell ---
unmatched <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(tcr_reactivity)), reactive_idx)
print(tcr_reactivity[unmatched, c("patient", "TCRa", "TCRb")])
table(patient = meta$patient, reactive = !is.na(reactive_idx))
rm(tcr_reactivity, reactive_idx, unmatched, meta)
# --- Category: Reactive vs Other (the table lists only reactive TCRs; the rest cannot be split) ---
object$category <- ifelse(
  !is.na(object$reactive) & object$reactive == "yes",
  "Reactive",
  "Other"
)
object@meta.data$Mutation[is.na(object@meta.data$Mutation)] <- "NA"
object@meta.data$reactive[is.na(object@meta.data$reactive)] <- "NA"
```

# annotations.

CD8+ non-naïve annotation, used only for the additional CD8+ non-naïve evaluation in m05 (the main evaluation uses all cells, which are not removed here).
Cell type by scGate (same PBMC model as in vhio136; there is no MAGIC/pdfCluster step in this cohort) and functional states of CD8+ T cells by ProjecTILs (CD8T reference, as in m02). Signature scores are not affected: UCell is computed on the RNA counts layer.
scGate: <https://github.com/carmonalab/scGate>
ProjecTILs: <https://github.com/carmonalab/ProjecTILs>

```{r, warning=FALSE}
object <- NormalizeData(object, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)
# --- Pinned scGate DB version (identical to master as of 2026-10) ---
scGate_models_DB <- get_scGateDB(version = "v0.17")
models.pbmc <- scGate_models_DB$human$PBMC
object <- scGate(object, assay = "RNA", model = models.pbmc, return.CellOntology = FALSE)
object$scGate_multi <- ifelse(is.na(object$scGate_multi), "unknown", object$scGate_multi)
object$celltype <- dplyr::case_when(
  object$scGate_multi == "CD8T" ~ "cd8",
  object$scGate_multi == "CD4T" ~ "cd4",
  TRUE ~ "unknown"
)
table(object$patient, object$celltype)
rm(scGate_models_DB, models.pbmc)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
ref.use <- load.reference.map(ref = file.path(project_dir, "setup", "refs", "CD8T_human_ref_v1.rds"))
cd8_cells <- subset(object, subset = celltype == "cd8")
set.seed(SEED)
cd8_cells <- make.projection(cd8_cells, ref = ref.use, filter.cells = FALSE, skip.normalize = TRUE, ncores = REPRO_NCORES)
cd8_cells <- cellstate.predict(ref = ref.use, query = cd8_cells)
object <- AddMetaData(object, cd8_cells@meta.data[, c("functional.cluster", "functional.cluster.conf")])
table(object$patient, object$functional.cluster, useNA = "ifany")
rm(ref.use, cd8_cells)
```
